scope: Targeted official-document review of 11 sampled access claims plus 86 additional rows; three rows remain unresolved. Source checks support core auth/access/API claims but do not constitute full endpoint conformance tests.
sample_selection: Purposive sample of higher-risk auth/access cases, not random; not population accuracy.

first_pass.basis: Four documented product-specific access-gate corrections were made in the existing case study; each represents one sampled app gate claim.

after_verification.basis: All 11 sampled coarse auth/access claims were checked against current official documentation; do not generalize to all fields/apps.

corrections.initial_gap: Treated production access as a developer-token approval gate.
corrections.verified: As of 2026-09-09, legacy developer tokens were sunset; API access levels are managed per Google Cloud project. Test access follows API enablement; Explorer+ is needed for production, and feature permissions differ.

corrections.initial_gap: Collapsed free sandbox and live access into a generic production-review gate.
corrections.verified: Sandbox is free; new eligible US/Canada teams can use a free Trial plan since 2026-04-15; full production eligibility/product coverage remains separate.

corrections.initial_gap: Did not fully distinguish developer qualification from seller consent.
corrections.verified: Developer registers and qualifies for required roles; public apps need Appstore approval, then sellers separately authorize.

corrections.initial_gap: Initial pass did not fully state program review prerequisites.
corrections.verified: Marketing API permissions are 3-legged OAuth; access requires application/program prerequisites and review.

full_run.interpretation: The current concurrent runner attempted all 100 URLs and all failed with Windows DNS resolution errors (getaddrinfo failed). This records the network restriction of this workspace, not app/API availability. The earlier project state recorded a separate 90/100 successful fetch run, but it produced only page-level signals and did not adjudicate claims. Current run output is authoritative for this runner version.

mcp.coverage: 29 first-party MCP offerings or connectors confirmed. Targeted MCP/product-surface checks now cover 39 app rows; 61 have not received a systematic status check. No negative conclusion is inferred from blank/unchecked rows. Product-specific offerings can have plan, region, tenant, or preview limits.

deployment.note: No connected publishing credentials or source-hosting integration is available in this workspace; local HTML and source are ready, but public deployment/repository publication remain uncompleted.
